name: Some Beaches Grilled Chicken & Avocado Flour Tortilla Wrap (Hold Ranch)
whyItWorks: Lean chicken, creamy soluble-fiber avocado, and bacon wrapped in a soft white flour tortilla make a lighter beach-day lunch than fried baskets.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Avocado Chicken Wrap with grilled chicken, avocado, bacon, and cheddar—hold the buttermilk ranch dressing, raw lettuce, and chipotle sauce.
watchOuts: Skip the Chipotle Shrimp wrap (spicy capsaicin) and dairy ranch
